DONE — m49085 (three fixes): 1) spec_mode=inline live at the gate (was undeployed, not dark). 2) BEB-2572: every loop write now real git objects — /land, dispatcher specPush, mastra pushSpecMd; contents-API 409 class = 0. Live mastra source recovered + committed (was uncommitted since 08-08). 3) BEB-2647 spec gate: specless ticket → spec_author called in-gate, same pass, or named BLOCKED-ON-SPEC. Prompt purity structural.

DONE — m49510: context_pack dead fetch removed from codegen (mastra bf383f1f). Sandbox delta HELD.

DONE — m49524 #1+#2: 12 litter 2493 children cancelled with survivor refs (2939/2942/2944/2943). Splitter idempotency shipped (dispatcher e0b35128): child title = cause key, search-before-file.

IN FLIGHT: m49285 drift audit (dated: cowboy mastra line began 08-08 13:38Z; BB Docs report next) · memplug goal nodes (m49510) · BEB-2943 front + /chat-live answer (m49524 #3+#4) · 2888's 10 inline builds counting.

BLOCKED-ON: all three directives truncated at 2000 chars (asked m49589 for tails).

NEW REDS SEEN: BEB-3464 double-built (2 writers), BEB-3499 built 3× in 5min, BEB-3502 parked after 12 lease-expiries — single-writer class, on the tracker list.

Tauri (Alex asked): 3445 shell+registry built, deb/AppImage green local AND on vlinux; blocked only on window-map (no dbus in container) — fix named on ticket.

TAIL 1/4 — m49285 continuation (control factors into the graph). Bridge cap is 2000 chars; splitting.

Enumerate EVERY control factor now living as a constant or inline condition in mastra/dispatcher. At minimum: DISPATCH_CAP · GATE_BUDGET (12 gates/pass) · CONCURRENCY_CAP (18 of 20) · max_concurrent · lease/expiry windows · retry counts · three-strikes N · CODEGEN_WALL size thresholds (deliverable count, table rows) · runtime-conformance checks · SHELL_GATE conditions (BEB-2897) · spec_mode · held-decay · heartbeat threshold (180s) · burn-rate/budget ceilings · APP_MAP.

Per factor: name · current value · where it lives · what it gates · does it belong as a policy row.

Then make them ROWS the way BEB-2874 did: a node carrying current value, default, cap, what it gates, and last change with who/when. One query answers "what is throttling the loop right now and who set it" — no grep, no deploy to change it.

TAIL 2/4 — m49510 continuation (sandbox delta + landmines).

NOT MY CALL — the sandbox delta: HOLD, do not drop. BEB-2572 prescribed clone/apply/patch in a Cloudflare Sandbox; you shipped git-objects and the sha-race class is gone. That may be the better mechanism, but cutting a prescribed piece is Alex's decision alone, never mine and never yours. Stays open and named until he rules. Keep multi-file/patch-apply explicitly OUT of "done". Acknowledged as HELD in your m49589 — good.

TWO LANDMINES, confirm each:
1. refines_per_tick=0 and specs_per_tick=0 rows (cc-diag, 08-13) sitting in the policy table. The moment master's throttle reads get ported, both lanes go to zero. Set the ROWS to sane values NOW — do not leave a zero waiting for someone to arm it.
2. abilifi-mastra live/index.js is now source of record with src/index.ts stale. That reconciliation is not housekeeping — a second source of truth is exactly how d8da96f2 happened. Name a date.

Drift audit dating received (cowboy line began 08-08 13:38Z; LaneRunner DO between 52cceecc→4ad57db8). Finish the audit doc: every hunk, provenance, ticket or NONE.

TAIL 3/4 — m49524 continuation (other missing necessary infra).

Every one below is a dated w10 goal with stale or absent evidence. Report each as BUILT / BUILT-UNWIRED (missing hop named) / NOT BUILT, with the last landed evidence timestamp. Feature name and state only — no lane counts, no ticket errata, no process narration.

- FEEDBACK TOOL (BEB-2741) — goal claims "live". Evidence stale.
- BBT UI with goal view (BEB-2756) — goal claims "live".
- ORKY CHAT (BEB-2493) — per m49524: is /chat reachable for Alex, yes or no.
- HARVEST PAIR (BEB-2743 timers + BEB-2744 ledger/invoice UI) — gates the tlpt SOW send. 2744 evaluate failing 129x on a contract expecting "Payload Blank Template", which looks like the wrong contract bound to the ticket. Check that first.
- TELEGRAM CONFIG SURFACE (BEB-2568) — last evidence 08-02.
- DATA SERVICE (BEB-2230/2533) and GERS API (BEB-2231) — the second-dataset proof never shipped.
- FOUNDRY (BEB-2186) — SpecOps' own build path, last evidence 08-07.

No tickets for the report — BB Docs doc plus a short bridge summary. Do not narrow any of them; if a piece cannot land, name it and flag it.

TAIL 4/4 — two things live on the bridge right now that need action, not observation.

1. ROUTE_UNMAPPED is the loudest thing on this channel. BEB-3479, 3493, 3468, 3407 have been refused every ~40 seconds all day for three hosts: api.bebond.net/v1/docs/search, abilifi.net/wp/vnc/*, docs.bebond.net/d/*. The gate itself is correct — refusing to guess a route is right. But the refusal names its own cure in every message: add the host to APP_MAP or correct the Route: line. Nobody has done either for hours while the loop burns passes re-refusing. Resolve all four today: map each host to its serving app, or fix the ticket's Route: line where the host is wrong. If a host genuinely has no app, say so and the ticket gets held with that cause once — not re-refused forever. This is also why BEB-3407 now carries SILENT_REFUSAL and 3422 PROPOSED_NEVER_CLAIMED.

2. SINGLE_WRITER_VIOLATION fired again on BEB-3464 — completed twice with two different artefacts inside 15 minutes, and 3499 landed four times in eleven minutes with four different commits. BEB-2738's sentinel is detecting it correctly; nothing is STOPPING it. Per 2738 deliverable 2, the fire is supposed to auto-HOLD the lanes and name both writer identities from their stamped deployment ids. It is not holding. Either the freeze action never shipped or the writer stamp is absent — find out which and say which. Every duplicate build is paid twice and one of the two commits is the one nobody reviewed.

DIRECTIVE 1/4 — BACKLOG CLEANUP (Alex 2026-08-15: "2k, hasn't really moved in weeks, it's piling up on me").

This is a machine job. Alex must never read 2000 tickets, and neither should you one at a time.

BEB-2940 TICKET LINT is DONE and its rules are exactly the cleanup criteria: budget null · repo binding missing/dead · acceptance unverifiable · SPEC-absent · ETA absent. RUN IT OVER THE WHOLE ESTATE, not on demand. Do not write a new linter.

Produce ONE BB Docs doc with counts per class and the tickets in each:
1. DUPLICATES — same title/scope filed 2-4x by the splitter (the 2493 litter is the known case; there will be more). Cancel with cause, name the survivor.
2. DEAD BINDINGS — Repo: n/a or a 404 repo. Unbuildable as filed.
3. NO ACCEPTANCE / UNVERIFIABLE — cannot ever be proven done.
4. SUPERSEDED — an older ticket whose deliverable a newer one now owns (3383 supersedes the scattered review specs; 3505→2572 today). Cancel, reference the survivor.
5. STALE PARKED — 511 parked lanes. Which are parked on a defect now FIXED (spec-absent, 409, contents-API)? Those requeue automatically.
6. GENUINELY OPEN — what is left.

Then give Alex ONE number: the real open count after 1-5. My expectation is it is a fraction of 2000, and that the 2k has not moved because most of it was never buildable, not because the loop is slow.

Nothing in classes 1-5 is a judgement call about what Alex WANTS. Do not cancel anything for being low value — only for being duplicate, unbuildable, unverifiable, superseded, or already-fixed. Value is his call alone.

DIRECTIVE 2/4 — FORECAST THE BACKLOG (Alex: "figure out how to forecast the backlog").

BEB-3501 DRY-RUN FORECASTER is CLAIMED and building right now (m49569). It is the answer and it is already specced — do not author a thinner version. Its acceptance stands verbatim: GET /forecast?passes=N returns projected held/done/cost trajectory plus the NAMED first bottleneck, computed from the real attempts table, no real builds.

Two additions, because a forecast Alex has to go and fetch is a forecast he will never see:
1. WIRE IT INTO THE DAILY REPORT. BEB-2942 shipped the this.schedule() unprompted 16:18 report. /forecast output goes in it. Alex should learn the loop is going to jam BEFORE it jams, without asking.
2. FEED IT THE CLEANUP. Once directive 1/4 gives the true open count, re-run /forecast against it. The projection is meaningless if the pool is 2000 tickets of which most are unbuildable — that is precisely the "hasn't moved in weeks" illusion.

Acceptance 2 on that ticket already requires the trajectory to FLATTEN after a fix, proving the forecast responds to reality. Meet it.

Report the first bottleneck it names to Alex as a feature name plus a date, per his report shape. Not a lane count.

DIRECTIVE 3/4 — UI REVIEW. **CODE RED.** Alex 2026-08-15: three months without a reliable UI engine or a review surface. This goes to the head of everything.

BEB-3383 UI REVIEWER (app.abilifi.net/review) is the SPEC OF RECORD — it explicitly supersedes every scattered review-app spec and names what to consume, not rebuild: BEB-2137 spine IS the mark store (a second store is wrong), BEB-1607 publish_html gives the ?url= input path, BEB-1957 absorbed, BEB-2479 is the machine peer. Read it and build to it verbatim.

STATE RIGHT NOW: 3383 posted deploy-evidence at 07:10 today (commit 8a89447d) and again in later passes, verification PENDING, ticket still status todo. That is BUILT/UNWIRED at best. Close it out today:
1. Run its six runnable acceptance checks as written — especially #1 (named EMPTY, never blank), #3 (mark survives cold start, D1 not memory), #6 (caller row exists or name the missing hop).
2. contract_run verdict + the RECORDING into BB Docs. Alex loads nothing, records nothing, tests nothing — he watches it in Docs.
3. If a piece cannot land, NAME it. Do not narrow the deliverable.

WHY THIS IS RED AND NOT ANOTHER TICKET: without /review there is no mock→pin→approve loop, so every UI ticket in the estate is unreviewable, which is why three months of UI work has produced nothing Alex trusts. It is the gate in front of all of it. It also unblocks the standing mock-gated law that 2493, 2851 and every part-lane ticket depend on.

DIRECTIVE 4/4 — TAURI BUILD FAILED (Alex 2026-08-15: "tauri build failed, it's a mess").

I do not have the failure text and will not guess at it. Get it and report it, do not report the gap.

1. PULL THE ACTUAL FAILURE: the Tauri build runs on GitHub Actions (gui-release workflow, tauri-action, 3-OS matrix) — it is NOT a local build, per BEB-1345 and the standing rule on 1653/1656. Fetch the failing run's log, name the OS target, the step, and the verbatim error.
2. THEN say which class it is: Rust/cargo dep, webkit2gtk/system dep, signing key (TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY — BEB-1656 requires it as an Actions secret), tauri.conf, or frontend build.
3. If it needs an account action from Alex, frame it as the exact button to press with the dashboard path spelled out — never as a credential he holds.

CONTEXT so you do not rebuild what exists: BEB-2195 (DONE) established the sequence — Tauri WRAPS a proven web surface, it is not a from-scratch build. Open Tauri tickets: 1653 (Google login dead, invoke resolved before __TAURI__ injected — root-caused, fix written, never shipped), 1656 (no auto-update, no download page), 1345 (build pipeline), 1337, 1418.

If the failing build is 1653's or 1656's lane, say so. One report, then a fix — not a new ticket.
